quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Category-captain leader in consumer spices, seasonings, and flavors. GAAP ROIC of 9.6% is heavily depressed by $8.6B in accumulated goodwill and intangibles from the RB Foods (Frank's/French's) and Cholula transactions; operating ROIC on tangible invested capital exceeds 100%, normalized to the 35.0% cap under the v6.23 M&A goodwill neutralization principle. Balance sheet deleveraging continues steadily (Net Debt/NI reduced to 3.8x, interest coverage 5.5x). Peak Owner EPS of $2.97 in FY2025 is a genuine all-time high with ~89% cash conversion. 5-10Y through-the-cycle growth of 5.5% reflects 1.5% organic volume, 2.0% pricing/mix, 1.5% margin recovery/deleveraging, and 0.5% bolt-on M&A.
